findings.detail: The new exception reason says an unreachable tmux pane skips attention logging. With valid hook input and a failing tmux lookup, read_tmux returns success and emit_event continues to append the event, retaining the socket and pane fields already assigned. The reason should describe unavailable tmux name metadata rather than a skipped event.
findings.evidence: read_tmux assigns TMUX_SOCKET and TMUX_PANE_ID at lines 320–321 and returns 0 on lookup failure at line 323. Its caller emit_event calls read_tmux at line 256, then builds the event and calls append_line at line 271.
findings.title: Docs drift: failed tmux lookup does not skip attention logging

findings.detail: The new exception reason says a missing session ID skips session-specific state, but state handling continues with an empty ID in the key. For a payload without either session-ID field, the script still creates a cache directory and uses its completion marker. Describe the fallback key and continued state handling so the exception does not imply that state writes are bypassed.
findings.evidence: Immediately after the empty-ID fallback at line 1105, lines 1106–1108 derive SESSION_KEY, assign STATE_DIR and create it unconditionally. Turn-start handlers remove its completed marker at line 1111, and fire_alerter_detached creates that marker for completion events at line 806.
findings.title: Docs drift: missing session IDs still use completion state
